# link-preview

Install:

```
composer require rasuvaeff/link-preview          # brings rasuvaeff/json-ld, rasuvaeff/schema, rasuvaeff/result
composer require rasuvaeff/pinned-http-client    # recommended PSR-18 client (DNS pinning); any PSR-18 client + PSR-17 request factory works
```

## Rules

- PHP 8.3+, `declare(strict_types=1)`, ext dom/libxml/mbstring/intl/ctype/filter
- Everything returns `Rasuvaeff\Result\Result`; nothing throws on bad input from a user or the network (`fetchMedia()` throws `InvalidArgumentException` only for a bad type list / limit: a programming error)
- The PSR-18 client MUST NOT follow redirects (`PinnedClient` does not, do not wrap it in `RedirectFollower`; Guzzle `allow_redirects => false`): `Fetcher` follows them itself and applies `UrlPolicy` to every hop
- No DNS pinning inside the package; close rebinding with `rasuvaeff/pinned-http-client` whose `AddressPolicy` is `UrlPolicy::allowsAddress()` (see Quickstart), or a trusted resolving egress proxy; timeouts belong to the client
- `PageInfo::$url` = the fetched URL (after redirects, normalised) - link the card here; `canonicalUrl` = what the page claims (`og:url`, canonical, JSON-LD, adapter), any host, dedup only
- Text fields are CLEAN plain text: entities decoded (double escaping too), tags removed, whitespace/control chars collapsed, then clipped; still escape when rendering
- Failures are value objects: `PreviewFailure` / `FetchFailure` with `reason` enum, `status`, `retryAfterSeconds`, `isTransient()`
- Source priority per field: site adapter > oEmbed (discovered) > JSON-LD > OpenGraph > Twitter Cards > HTML; image + its width/height merge as one field
- Built-in adapters are internal: `AdapterRegistry::standard(...)`, custom ones first via `->with(...)`
- Adapter tokens (Instagram, Facebook required; Twitter optional) are `standard()` args, sent as Authorization headers to the API host only, never in URLs; no token = AdapterFailure::MissingToken, no request
- Namespace `Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview`

## Quickstart

```php
use GuzzleHttp\Psr7\HttpFactory;
use Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview\Fetch\Fetcher;
use Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview\Fetch\UrlPolicy;
use Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview\Fetch\UserAgentMap;
use Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview\Limits;
use Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview\PreviewProvider;
use Rasuvaeff\PinnedHttpClient\AddressPolicy;
use Rasuvaeff\PinnedHttpClient\PinnedClient;

$policy = new UrlPolicy(allowedNetworks: [], allowedPorts: [80, 443]);

$provider = new PreviewProvider(
    fetcher: new Fetcher(
        client: new PinnedClient(
            policy: new class ($policy) implements AddressPolicy {
                public function __construct(private UrlPolicy $policy) {}
                public function allows(string $address): bool { return $this->policy->allowsAddress($address); }
            },
            timeoutSeconds: 5.0,
            connectTimeoutSeconds: 3.0,
            maxBodyBytes: 2_097_153, // > Fetcher maxBodyBytes, so oversize = FetchFailureReason::TooLarge
        ),
        requestFactory: new HttpFactory(),
        policy: $policy,
        userAgents: UserAgentMap::unfurler(['t.me' => 'TelegramBot (like TwitterBot)']), // Twitterbot/1.0 everywhere
        maxRedirects: 5,
        maxBodyBytes: 2_097_152,
        chainBudgetSeconds: 10.0, // checked between hops only
    ),
    extractors: null, // default: OEmbedExtractor, JsonLdExtractor, OpenGraphExtractor, TwitterCardsExtractor, HtmlFallbackExtractor
    limits: new Limits(titleLength: 200, descriptionLength: 500, siteNameLength: 100, authorNameLength: 100, maxUrlLength: 2048, httpsImagesOnly: false),
    adapters: null,   // default: AdapterRegistry::standard(); new AdapterRegistry() = off
    hostAsSiteName: false, // true: siteName falls back to the host of url without www. (ASCII)
);

$result = $provider->preview(url: 'https://example.com/article'); // Result<PageInfo, PreviewFailure>
$result = $provider->fromHtml(html: $html, pageUrl: 'https://example.com/a', charset: 'windows-1251'); // pageUrl must pass UrlPolicy, else PolicyRejected

$info = $result->unwrap();
$info->url; $info->canonicalUrl; $info->title; $info->description; $info->image; $info->imageWidth; $info->imageHeight;
$info->favicon; $info->siteName; $info->providerName; $info->language; $info->authorName; $info->publishedTime; $info->type; $info->embedUrl;
// strings/ints are nullable except url; publishedTime ?DateTimeImmutable; imageWidth/imageHeight ?int (>= 1, only with image)
$array = $info->toArray();               // 15 keys, PageInfoArray psalm shape
$same = PageInfo::fromArray($array);     // inverse; missing keys = null; wrong types -> InvalidArgumentException
```

### Failures

```php
$failure = $result->error(); // ?PreviewFailure
$failure->reason;            // PreviewFailureReason
$failure->status;            // ?int<100,599>, for HttpStatus
$failure->retryAfterSeconds; // ?int<0,max>: Retry-After delta-seconds, or HTTP-date minus response Date; capped at 86400
$failure->isTransient();     // retry later?
```

| reason | transient |
|---|---|
| PolicyRejected | no |
| Network (client threw NetworkExceptionInterface; pinned ResolutionFailed = DNS) | yes |
| ClientRefused (any other ClientExceptionInterface, e.g. pinning refusal of an address) | no |
| TooManyRedirects, InvalidRedirect | no |
| BudgetExceeded | yes |
| HttpStatus | yes for 408, 425, 429, 5xx; else no |
| UnexpectedContentType | no |
| TooLarge (Fetcher limit, fetchMedia maxBytes, or a pinning client's ResponseTooLarge) | no |
| EmptyBody (fetchMedia only: empty 2xx body) | no |
| MissingToken | no |
| EmptyPage | no |

`FetchFailure` / `FetchFailureReason` (Fetcher) have the same shape and reasons without MissingToken/EmptyPage; `PreviewFailure::fromFetch()` maps.

### Decorating

```php
use Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview\LinkPreviewer; // preview(string $url): Result; fromHtml(string $html, string $pageUrl, ?string $charset = null): Result

final class Cached implements LinkPreviewer { /* store $info->toArray(), read with PageInfo::fromArray(); do not cache transient failures */ }
```

### Limits (clean text)

title/description/siteName/authorName/providerName: mb_scrub -> html_entity_decode (repeat, max 4 rounds) -> tags/comments/doctypes
replaced by a space (`a < b`, `<3` stay) -> `[\s\p{Cc}]+` to one space, trim -> clip by characters with `…` (counts toward the limit).
Text escaped deeper than 4 levels: remaining `&`/`<` become `＆`/`＜`. Idempotent; output has no decodable entity and no tag.
Markup-only values become null and fall through to the next source during the merge.
providerName uses siteNameLength. image/favicon/embedUrl over maxUrlLength (or http with httpsImagesOnly) dropped, image with its sizes;
canonicalUrl over maxUrlLength dropped.

### UrlPolicy

```php
$policy = new UrlPolicy();
$policy->check(url: 'HTTPS://Example.COM:443/a#f'); // Result<string, UrlRejection>, ok = 'https://example.com/a'
$policy->allowsAddress('93.184.216.34');            // bool: plain IPv4/IPv6 literal, same ranges + allowedNetworks as check()
// UrlRejection: Malformed, Scheme, Credentials, MissingHost, InvalidHost, NonCanonicalIp, Port, PrivateAddress
```

Rejected: non-http(s) schemes, credentials, ports other than 80/443 (configurable), localhost and *.localhost,
loopback/private/link-local/CGNAT/documentation/multicast/reserved IPv4 and IPv6, IPv6 carrying IPv4
(::7f00:1, ::ffff:a.b.c.d, 64:ff9b::/96, 2002::/16), decimal/hex/octal/short IPv4 spellings, control characters.
IDN hosts are converted to ASCII. Names are never resolved. `allowedNetworks` (CIDR or address list) opens private networks for dev;
`localhost` names count as 127.0.0.1.

### Fetcher

```php
$page = $fetcher->fetch(url: 'https://example.com/');          // Result<FetchedPage, FetchFailure>; text/html, application/xhtml+xml
$json = $fetcher->fetchJson(url: $api, headers: ['Authorization' => 'Bearer <token>']); // headers to the first host only
$img = $fetcher->fetchMedia(url: $info->image, acceptedTypes: ['image/*', 'video/mp4'], maxBytes: 5_242_880); // own limit
$fetcher->check(url: $url);                                    // Result<string, UrlRejection>
// FetchedPage: url (final), body, contentType (lower-case, no params), charset, redirects
```

2xx only, body <= limit (Content-Length checked first). Redirects 301/302/303/307/308, `Location` resolved against the current URL,
policy checked before each request. fetchMedia types: lower-case `type/subtype` or `type/*`.
The client's own body limit still applies to fetchMedia (PinnedClient maxBodyBytes < maxBytes -> TooLarge):
use a separate media Fetcher over `$pinned->withMaxBodyBytes($mediaMax)` when media may be larger than pages.
An empty 2xx body is EmptyBody.

### Extractors and documents

```php
use Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview\Html\PageDocument;
use Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview\Extract\OpenGraphExtractor;

$document = PageDocument::parse(html: $bytes, charset: 'utf-8'); // charset: transport > BOM > <meta charset> > UTF-8
$document->title(); $document->language(); $document->baseHref();
$document->meta('og:title');      // list<string>, matches property or name, case-insensitive
$document->links('icon');         // list<string>, rel token match
$document->images();              // list<array{src, width, height}>

(new OpenGraphExtractor())->extract(document: $document, pageUrl: 'https://example.com/')
    ; // Result<Metadata, ExtractFailure::NoMetadata>
```

Implement `Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview\Extract\Extractor` to add a source; pass it in `extractors:` (highest priority first).
`Metadata` fields: url (claimed -> canonicalUrl), title, description, image, favicon, siteName, language, authorName,
publishedTime, type, embedUrl, imageWidth, imageHeight, providerName.
Sizes: og:image:width/height (first), twitter:image:width/height, <img width height>, oEmbed thumbnail_width/height
(photo: width/height), JSON-LD ImageObject width/height (number, digits, QuantitativeValue); positive int < 100000.

### Site adapters

```php
use Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview\Adapter\AdapterRegistry;

AdapterRegistry::standard(
    twitterToken: null,          // optional
    instagramToken: '<token>',   // required for Instagram, else MissingToken
    facebookToken: '<token>',    // required for Facebook, else MissingToken
    twitchParents: ['example.com'], // needed for a Twitch embedUrl
)->with(new MyAdapter());        // custom adapters first; first matching domain wins (override a built-in)
```

YouTube, TikTok, Twitter/X, Twitch (oEmbed), Wikipedia (REST summary), GitHub (OG, gists), Instagram, Facebook (Graph API oEmbed),
Telegram (OG + widget), VK (OG + video_ext.php), Rutube (video API). Hosts match by labels: www./m./subdomains yes,
`youtube.com.evil.example` no. Custom site: implement `Adapter` (`domains(): list<string>`, `preview(string $url, AdapterContext $context): Result<Metadata, AdapterFailure>`)
and use `$context->html($url)` / `$context->json($url, $headers)` - the only way to reach the network, always under UrlPolicy.
JSON answers are shape-checked; a wrong-typed field = AdapterFailure::InvalidResponse + `$context->diagnostics()` (paths only, no values).
AdapterFailure: MissingToken, UnsupportedUrl, Unavailable, InvalidResponse.
